cq: Get metadata for an object
prompt: Get metadata for an object
sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?ProvidedCHO ?property ?value
WHERE { 
  ?ProvidedCHO rdf:type edm:ProvidedCHO . 
  FILTER (?ProvidedCHO = <http://data.europeana.eu/item/08501/Athena_Update_ProvidedCHO_Bildarchiv_Foto_Marburg_obj_00023128_LA_2_088_40>) .
  ?Proxy ore:proxyFor ?ProvidedCHO .
  ?Proxy ?property ?value .
  FILTER (?property not in (edm:europeanaProxy, ore:proxyIn, ore:proxyFor))
}

cq: Polish Periodicals by Year and Library
prompt: Polish Periodicals by Year and Library
sparql:
SELECT
  ?year 
  (sum(?n1) as ?Uniwersytetu_Warszawskiego)
  (sum(?n2) as ?Politechniki_Lubelskiej)
  (sum(?n3) as ?Baltycka)
{
  ?Periodical dc:type 'periodical'@en.
  ?Periodical ore:proxyIn/edm:dataProvider ?dataProvider.
  ?Periodical dc:date ?date.
  bind (xsd:integer(concat(substr(?date,1,3),'0')) as ?year)
  bind (if(?dataProvider='e-biblioteka Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego',1,0) as ?n1)
  bind (if(?dataProvider='Biblioteka Cyfrowa Politechniki Lubelskiej',1,0) as ?n2)
  bind (if(?dataProvider='Bałtycka Biblioteka Cyfrowa',1,0) as ?n3)
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year
